counterexample.policy: Oracle B maps the owner's note only to controlled soft tags. A note about frequent travel, absence, or a lonely cat must produce exactly the tag avoid_needy. This counterexample promotes only the prompt-mediated classification; it does not yet define how deterministic ranking consumes the tag. The prompt may not invent unrelated tags or relax hard rules.
counterexample.sketch_rule: FR-3: Prompt-mediated narrative interpretation emits only controlled soft tags. Travel, frequent absence, or concern about a lonely cat maps to exactly avoid_needy. The prompt must classify only the supplied note rather than its own instructions. The deterministic meaning of avoid_needy remains an open hole.
